How to Play

🕹️ 👆Left stick: move
Drag on the right: look around
⬆️ 🥚Eggs float high and glow. Press JUMP under one to grab it!
🔴 ➜Carry it to the incubator in the middle of the room. A golden arrow shows the way.
🐲 🎉Fill all 16 slots and a baby dragon hatches! Beat your best time!
